propositions: When a completion verify run has banked an operator-actionable BLOCK criterion and then encounters a provider outage (LLMUnavailableError), it must finalize a deterministic FAIL verdict from the bank with no further LLM calls instead of dying verdict-less.
A degrade verdict from the banked BLOCK must be certifiable=False and must not auto-close the ticket without an operator decision; it flows to close_precheck's non-close, findings-surfacing branch.
Empty-bank or PASS-only criterion banks must preserve the retryable exit-11 posture on outage; only actionable BLOCKs (met=False AND evidence_sufficient!=False) trigger degrade.
The degrade path is guarded so any fault in bank-read or criteria assembly falls through to re-raise the outage unchanged, never introducing a new failure mode on the outage path.
Retryable outages follow bounded retry-with-backoff per ADR 0040 with a clear operator message on terminal exhaustion; no 'sustained outage' detection is implemented.
